svg.title: Brighter Future Mediation CRM application architecture and data flow
svg.desc: Editable architecture diagram showing people and public entry points, the React frontend, Express CRM server, PostgreSQL and AWS S3 storage, background jobs, external integrations, and a sixteen-item data-transfer ledger.

g.text: BFM CRM — Application Architecture & Data Flow

emails, calendars, enquiries, WhatsApp conversations and audit logs.

g.text: Important boundary: Google Drive is not CRM document storage

text.tspan: The enquiry acknowledgement email may include a link to BFM information held in a Google Drive folder.
For this Drive resource, the CRM includes its URL in the HTML email; it does not send Drive file contents.
There is no implemented CRM upload API to Google Drive. Case documents and evidence are stored in AWS S3, with metadata and access controls held in PostgreSQL.

g.text: Source basis: current server routes, services, jobs and shared schema • Diagram contains categories only—no live credentials, secrets or customer records.
